title: Scope all Babulus data by Prospectus account and authorize every action
description: Security gap today: every model in apps/studio-web/amplify/data/resource.ts is allow.authenticated() and tenancy is enforced only in app code via a string orgId. Use the Prospectus account UUID as orgId everywhere, call accounts.authorize(account, op) before every server action and query (console:read / console:write / members:*), and keep packages/shared rbac as Babulus's own permissions capped by the Prospectus role. Replace getOrgsForUser/OrgMember reads with accounts.list(). Remove the Org, OrgMember and UserProfile models; keep BillingAccount and UsageEvent re-keyed by account until Prospectus has billing. Depends on the sign-in task.
